name: How much does a living room addition cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a living room addition cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a living room addition varies significantly based on its size, complexity, materials, and local labor rates. Small bump-outs can start at tens of thousands, while large, custom additions with high-end finishes might exceed $100,000. For an accurate estimate, Hometelligent Inc. provides detailed proposals after an initial consultation, considering your specific design choices and the unique characteristics of your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely based on size, complexity, and materials, ranging from tens of thousands to over $100,000. Hometelligent Inc. provides detailed proposals after consultation.
